menu.label: Add at least one menu item
menu.why: Your storefront is already public, and customers see an empty menu until you add items.

pin.label: Set the map pin
pin.why: Delivery fees and rider dispatch are measured from the pin, not from the address text.

hours.label: Save your opening hours
hours.why: With no hours saved, the storefront treats this branch as open around the clock.

payment.label: Switch on at least one payment method
payment.why: With every method off, customers cannot order pickup or schedule a delivery.

noPin.label: Delivery is on, but this branch has no map pin
noPin.why: Riders cannot be dispatched to delivery orders from this branch until the pin is set.

tax.label: Check the sales tax rate
tax.why: Sales tax is 0% here, so orders are charged no tax. Set this branch’s rate, or tick “0% is correct” under Sales tax if your prices already include it.

staff.label: Invite this branch’s staff
staff.why: Nobody works at this branch yet: invite its cashier and kitchen so they can use the counter and the kitchen board.

transferNoQr.label: Bank transfer is on, but this branch has no payment QR
transferNoQr.why: Customers cannot pay by transfer until this branch uploads its own QR. Another branch’s QR is never used.

noRiders.label: Delivery is on, but no rider is approved for this branch
noRiders.why: Delivery orders from this branch cannot be offered to anyone until you approve riders for it.
